QuestInfo.name: [Masteria] Upon Crimsonwood Mountain
QuestInfo.0: You head to the Crimsonwood Mountain with Becky. Though you sense a murderous intent in the shadowed forest around the mountain, a small light guides your path. Begin by clearing out the Mysterious Knight monsters so you can safely look around the area.
